beats.text: They hugged me. Both of them. At the same time.
beats.quote: That is the entire event. A hug in a backyard.

beats.text: I'm going to tell you what it took to get there.
THE BACKYARD
One continent broke. Now there are islands.
beats.quote: I was born on one of them.

beats.text: A green comma in an enormous blue nothing.
beats.quote: Guam is thirty miles long. You can drive its whole length in an afternoon.

beats.text: The world is real. It's happening somewhere else.
beats.quote: You learn the shape of being downstream.

beats.text: Watching a bigger world arrive on a delay.
beats.quote: And quietly deciding I would rather be where it started.

beats.text: My parents divorced when I was ten.
beats.quote: Two houses. Two calendars. A kid with a backpack, moving between them.

beats.text: Family is not a relationship. It's the ground.
beats.quote: You keep the people. You lose the ground.

beats.text: What you get instead is a skill.
beats.quote: Fine in two places, fully at home in neither.

beats.text: 2020: finished high school, started writing music.
beats.quote: A song is the smallest thing that can hold more than one person at a time.

beats.text: A place that could hold several people at once.
beats.quote: And didn't require anybody to agree on anything.

beats.text: 2022: App Academy. Software engineer.
beats.quote: An app is a room. You build it alone and then strangers stand in it.

beats.text: The same activity, understood much later.
Day one, twice.
beats.quote: I was on ChatGPT day one. Network School, day one.

beats.text: Grew up on a delay. Now I go touch it that day.
beats.quote: I'd rather not do that again.

beats.text: 2025: longtermer number two.
beats.quote: I left an island to live on an island.

beats.text: Langkawi. Thirty-something miles across.
beats.quote: From the air, honestly, it looks like home.

beats.text: This one is full on purpose.
beats.quote: Five hundred founders, the same place, at the same time.

beats.text: Stranded versus gathered.
The pattern, laid out, isn't subtle.
What I've actually been building.
beats.quote: Wonderhall, Summon, Optimism, Pangaea

beats.text: A way to talk to who shaped you.
beats.quote: Rockefeller, Deutsch, Sivers, Naval.

beats.text: A map of what humanity wants.
beats.quote: Pangaea: named after the moment before the land broke.

beats.text: The same object, over and over.
beats.quote: With different materials.

beats.text: Ten years after. The three of us, standing together.
Fixed nothing. Undid nothing.
beats.quote: Everything that had come apart was back together.

beats.text: Continents don't reassemble.
beats.quote: That is real, and it is not sad. What happened instead is that things grew on the pieces.

beats.text: Born on an island. Living on one now.
beats.quote: The only real cure for scattered is to build somewhere worth gathering.

beats.text: THAT IS THE WHOLE STORY
